_comment: Frozen fixture data (SS8.1 item 8 of doc/experiment-minimum-context.md). The five product personas, the product_to_repo mapping and hours_table are copied verbatim from w2-branching/support-intake so the two fixtures stay comparable: the same item classified the same way costs the same hours in both. The repo mapping is NEVER shown to the model -- only the personas are, through the SOL document -- and exists here for offline ground-truth computation. What is new is `teams`: each team accepts a fixed set of products and stands as backup on another, and P4 appears in neither list for any team, which is the structural gap that produces UNASSIGNED. There is deliberately no budget_hours: the hour budget is injected per request as `remaining_hours` in the payload, computed by the oracle, never chained from the model's own previous answer (SS4.5).
